state.recap-2024-explanation:
- Days rated: you rated this number of days
- Average day rate: an average of all your rates since 2024.01.01
- Happiness: comparison of your average rate to the average rate of all other users
- Happiest and worst months: months with your highest and lowest (average) rates
- In a row: number of days when your life quality* was raising/falling/remaining the same.

*Life quality of a given day is an average rate of this and 6 previous days
